com.vector.cfg.dom.runtimesys.groovy.api

Interface ISelectedComponentPort


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface ISelectedComponentPort
    ISelectedComponentPort represents a selection of exactly one IComponentPort and provides further actions on it.

    • Method Detail

      • connectTo

        @PublishedMethod
IConnector connectTo(@Nonnull
                                       java.lang.String componentName,
                                       @Nonnull
                                       java.lang.String portName,
                                       @Nonnull
                                       java.util.Optional<java.lang.String> portInterfaceMapping)

        connectTo(String, String, Optional) creates an IConnector between the IComponentPort which is represented by this ISelectedComponentPort and the IComponentPort which is retrieved by the given component and port name. It is possible to connect the component port to a delegation port by using 'COMPOSITIONTYPE' as componentName.

        The ISelectedComponentPort will produce trace, info and warning logs. To see them, activate the 'com.vector.cfg.dom.runtimesys.groovy.api.ISelectedComponentPort' logger with the appropriate log level.

        Parameters:
        componentName - Name of the IComponent to connect. For delegation ports use 'COMPOSITIONTYPE' or 'ECU Composition'.
        portName - Name of the port to connect.
        portInterfaceMapping - An Optional containing the AUTOSAR path to the port interface mapping or Optional.empty() if no port interface mapping is used for the new connector.
        Returns:
        The created IConnector.
        Throws:
        SelectionException - When the component ports cannot be connected. See Automation Interface Documentation for more details about the checks.

      • removePortTerminator

        @PublishedMethod
IComponentPort removePortTerminator()
        removePortTerminator() simple API to remove the port terminator of the selected component port.

        See terminate() for more information about the purpose of terminating ports.

        Returns:
        Returns the selected component port.
        Throws:
        SelectionException - When no port terminator for this port can be removed, because it is for example removed or just has no port terminator.

      • terminate

        @PublishedMethod
IComponentPort terminate()
        terminate() simple API to terminate the selected IComponentPort if it is not already terminated or connected to another component port. You can use IComponentPort.isTerminated() to check if a port is terminated and IComponentPort.isConnected() if a port is connected to other ports.

        The termination of component ports disables the validation of these ports. In other words, these ports are acknowledged as not connected yet. This should give a better overview of the open ports, which still have to be connected or need a data mapping.

        Returns:
        Returns the selected component port.
        Throws:
        SelectionException - When the component port cannot be terminated, because it is for example already connected, terminated or removed.
